title: On the Intermediate Models of Strongly Compact Prikry Forcing
summary: We analyze the intermediate models of the strongly compact Prikry forcing. We exhibit a simple combinatorial property which, for a given supercompact cardinal $κ$, characterize the projections of all projections of the strongly compact Prikry forcing using $κ$-complete fine measures. Considering level-by-level results, if $κ$ is $2^λ$-strongly compact, we characterize the forcings of size $\leqλ$ which are projections of that $λ$-strongly compact Prikry forcing.
